title: Pure Eldlich
summary: Eldlich the Golden Lord with its Eldlixir and Golden Land cards, plus generic Rank 5s, Links and staples. Eldlich sends itself and a Spell/Trap from the hand to send any card on the field to the GY. From the GY it returns to the hand by sending a Spell/Trap you control, then summons a Zombie that can't be destroyed by effects. The Golden Land Traps summon themselves as Zombie monsters and add an effect while Eldlich is out, and each one banishes itself from the GY in the End Phase to Set an Eldlixir from the Deck. The Eldlixirs summon Eldlich and Set Golden Land cards in return, so the two halves loop. Cursed Eldland searches an Eldlich monster or a Golden Land card. The 2025 cards lead. Eldlixir of the Glorious Golden Land becomes a Level 10 Zombie that bounces a monster, or Sets a banished Golden Land or Eldlixir. Fallen Angel of the Golden Land summons an Eldlich from the Deck, Extra Deck or GY when it leaves the field.
